title: Zappmint
tagline: Turn any idea into a tokenized mini app using AI — built, deployed, and shared in seconds.
description:
Zappmint is an AI-powered platform that lets anyone turn a simple text prompt into a functional onchain mini app — called a Zapp — and automatically mint a token alongside it. Just type an idea like “make a meme coin leaderboard” or “build a claim page for my airdrop,” and Zappmint generates the frontend, deploys the logic, and launches a token tied to your Zapp. Each Zapp becomes a shareable, ownable asset onchain — no devs or setup required.

This makes Zappmint a powerful tool for creators, builders, and meme projects to instantly validate ideas, build community, and even raise initial funding — just by shipping a Zapp. Each app acts as both a product and a tokenized campaign, enabling early supporters to use it, earn its token, and rally behind it. With integrations like Flow for smooth UX, LayerZero for multichain deploys, Blockscout for tracking, and 1inch for DeFi utilities, Zappmint transforms app creation into a Web3-native, community-first experience.
how_its_made:
Zappmint is built with Next.js for the frontend and user interactions.
It’s powered by Llamacoder, an open-source AI coding agent, which interprets prompts and generates full-stack app code, including smart contracts and UI logic.

Together.ai handles the AI inference layer, enabling fast and scalable code generation.
Blockscout is integrated to display real-time transaction data and onchain activity for each Zapp.

Zappmint is also a World App Mini, built using Worldcoin’s MiniKit SDK, allowing verified identity support and seamless onboarding through the World App ecosystem.
